You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

Pd-catalysed Buchwald-Hartwig amination of 4-chloroanisole with 4-methylaniline; choose the ligand, base and isoxazole additive.

picks.reason: The strong result with A5 and BTMG makes testing this additive with the BrettPhos catalyst a high-value ligand comparison.
This tests whether the A5–BTMG result extends to tBuXPhos while holding the promising base and additive fixed.
AdBrettPhos provides a distinct, bulky catalyst to test whether the high-yielding A5 combination is ligand-specific.
Keeping the best-observed ligand and additive while changing the base tests whether P2Et can improve on BTMG.
A4 is the positional isomer of the dibenzylamino-isoxazole additive that gave the standout yield, so this probes additive structure while retaining the proven catalyst and base.
